title: Vibhishan: Ravan's Brother and Devotee of Shri Ram
description: Who is Vibhishan? Read how Ravan's younger brother meets Hanumanji, seeks refuge in Shri Ram and becomes king of Lanka in the Ramcharitmanas.
answer: Vibhishan is Ravan's younger half-brother, a devotee of the Lord and the king of Lanka after Ravan's defeat. In Goswami Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, he remembers Shri Ram while living among demons, welcomes Hanumanji and later seeks Shri Ram's refuge. His story teaches that devotion rests on the direction of the heart, even amid surroundings opposed to it.

sections.h2: Devotion in the midst of Lanka
sections.md:
Devotion is not determined by the family into which we are born. In Bal Kand, doha 176, Goswami Tulsidas identifies Vibhishan as Ravan's younger half-brother, a devotee of Lord Vishnu and a man of wisdom. When Brahma offers him a boon in Bal Kand, doha 177, he asks for pure love for the Lord's feet.

That love becomes visible in Sunderkand, doha 6. Hanumanji hears Vibhishan repeating Shri Ram's Name and approaches him in a Brahmin's form. After Hanumanji reveals his identity, both rejoice in remembering Shri Ram's virtues. Their meeting teaches us to recognise a devotee through remembrance of the Lord.

In Sunderkand, doha 42, Vibhishan leaves Ravan and turns towards Shri Ram with eager thoughts of beholding His feet. Goswami Tulsidas presents Ravan's rejection of this Saint as a loss of Ravan's own blessings. Vibhishan leaves with his heart fixed on the Lord.

Can someone coming from the enemy's side be received? Shri Ram answers this concern in Sunderkand, doha 44. He declares His protection for anyone who seeks refuge in Him, even considering the possibility that Vibhishan has come as a spy. He then sends Sugriv, Angad and Hanumanji to bring Vibhishan before Him. Surrender calls for sincerity, and the Lord receives the sincere heart.

Having sought refuge, Vibhishan places his understanding at Shri Ram's service. In Sunderkand, doha 50, he advises approaching the ocean for a means of crossing. In Sunderkand, doha 51, Shri Ram accepts his counsel and goes to the shore. The one who seeks shelter also takes responsibility for serving.

This trust continues in Lanka Kand, doha 67, when Shri Ram asks Sugriv, Vibhishan and Lakshman to care for the army. In Lanka Kand, doha 94, Vibhishan confronts Ravan in combat. Goswami Tulsidas makes the source of his courage clear: Shri Ram's strength enables him to face the brother he would otherwise fear.

In Sunderkand, doha 49, Goswami Tulsidas describes Shri Ram saving Vibhishan from Ravan's anger and bestowing enduring sovereignty upon him. After Ravan's defeat, Hanumanji reports Vibhishan's kingship to Mata Sita in Lanka Kand, doha 107. His enthronement is also recalled in Uttar Kand, doha 68.

Yet the story continues to show his love for Shri Ram. In Uttar Kand, doha 12, Vibhishan stands among those serving the Lord at His coronation. Receiving a kingdom does not bring his devotion to an end. His example gives us a practice: when the Lord grants a position or responsibility, let it become another means of service.

faq.q: How is Vibhishan related to Ravan?
faq.a: Vibhishan is Ravan's younger half-brother. Bal Kand, doha 176, identifies him as a devotee of Lord Vishnu and a man of wisdom. His family relationship does not determine his devotion. In Bal Kand, doha 177, when Brahma offers him a boon, Vibhishan asks for pure love for the Lord's feet.

faq.q: Was Vibhishan wrong to leave his brother?
faq.a: Goswami Tulsidas presents Vibhishan's departure as a devotee turning towards Shri Ram. In Sunderkand, doha 42, Ravan's rejection of Vibhishan brings the loss of his own blessings. In Sunderkand, doha 44, Shri Ram receives Vibhishan under His protection. The teaching places sincere surrender to the Lord above remaining with Ravan.

faq.q: What happens to Vibhishan after Ravan dies?
faq.a: Vibhishan becomes king of Lanka. In Lanka Kand, doha 107, Hanumanji tells Mata Sita of Ravan's defeat and Vibhishan's enduring kingship. Uttar Kand, doha 68, also recalls his enthronement. He remains devoted to Shri Ram and appears among those serving Him at His coronation in Uttar Kand, doha 12.
